name: shokai
description: Agents, introduced properly. Shōkai is an open protocol that gives online places a door for agents. This repository: the specification, SDK, conformance runner and reference implementations.
author: Yu Sung Yeh

scripts.setup: npm --prefix reference/engawa ci && npm --prefix reference/prototype ci && npm --prefix packages/shokai ci && npm --prefix tools/schema ci
scripts.enforce: ( [ -f packages/shokai/dist/src/index.js ] || npm --prefix packages/shokai run build --silent ) && node tools/enforce/enforce.mjs
